## Checklist

- [ ] Every added skill has a license that allows redistribution, and I kept its license and credit lines.
- [ ] Every added skill has an `ATTRIBUTION.md` with `collected_from` and `original_path`.
- [ ] New source projects are in `tools/credits.json`, with their license text in `licenses/`.
- [ ] Any change to a skill's own files is described in `tools/changes.json`.
- [ ] I ran `python tools/attribution.py`, `python tools/build_catalog.py` and `claude plugin validate .`, and committed the regenerated files.
